name: Arthur
source:
"Ahh, the light of a peaceful world shines here and now... The light that will envelop the world fills this very room..."

Based on King Arthur, who was the legendary British leader of the late 5th and early 6th centuries.

An idol hero who charms everyone with her overflowing charisma. Arthur travels around the world with her knights of the Round Table in order to create a peaceful world free of conflict.

She has come to Yamatai in order to see for herself the [url=/c5167]Hero[/url] who unified Zipang. She firmly believes that love is the answer to everything, which is why she wants of fill the whole world with it. However, her "love conquest" has been postponed many times because nobody actually knows what it means.

[Edited from [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char12a]English official site[/url]]
